children.name: repair
children.instructions:
Fix every OPEN finding in the `ledger`, at the level of its RULE, never just its repro.
A pristine, execute-only copy of the reference program is at /opt/pb/reference/executable. It survives rebuilds (./compile.sh overwrites ./executable), so always compare against that path.
For each finding:
1. Probe the reference with at least 3 variants of the repro (including other modes' output as input) to confirm the general rule before changing code.
2. Implement the rule. Never special-case one input.
3. Add cases for the finding to spec/cases and capture their expected output from the reference with spec/capture.sh.
Then rebuild with ./compile.sh and run `spec/run_cases.sh ./executable`: it must pass 100%, so you have not broken earlier behaviour. Commit.
